name: vault-jot
description: Capture ideas, takes, and reading items into an Obsidian vault inbox from any Claude Code session

vaultPath.title: Vault path
vaultPath.description: Absolute path (or ~/...) to the vault root; captures go to its inbox/ folder

backlogCount.title: Backlog count
backlogCount.description: Show the ingest band when the inbox holds at least this many captures

backlogDays.title: Backlog age (days)
backlogDays.description: Show the ingest band when the oldest capture is at least this many days old
